name: Chef Rajesh Kumar
bio: With over 20 years of experience in Indian cuisine, Chef Rajesh brings authentic flavors from traditional recipes passed down through generations.

name: Chef Priya Sharma
bio: Specializing in South Indian delicacies, Chef Priya creates innovative dishes that blend traditional techniques with modern presentation.

name: Chef Amit Patel
bio: Master of Indian sweets and desserts, Chef Amit crafts traditional mithai with a contemporary twist using the finest ingredients.

name: Chef Neha Kapoor
bio: Expert in traditional grilling techniques, Chef Neha brings out the smoky, rich flavors of Indian barbecue with finesse.

name: Chef Ravi Mehta
bio: Ravi’s curry recipes are a blend of classic and innovative flavors, offering guests a diverse range of authentic tastes.

name: Chef Anjali Desai
bio: Anjali designs exquisite vegetarian dishes that highlight the richness and variety of Indian vegetable cuisine.
